item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development and application of integrated digital models for the assessment of quality of life and clinical-functional outcomes in patients undergoing maxillofacial surgery. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Milano
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-15 Neurochirurgia e chirurgia maxillo-facciale

This project builds upon activities initiated under the BD4QoL project, which aimed to develop digital tools for collecting, integrating, and analyzing clinical data and patient-reported outcomes for patients undergoing head and neck surgery. Drawing on that experience, the project seeks to broaden the scope of quality-of-life and clinical-functional outcome assessment models, extending them to the wider fields of cervicofacial and maxillofacial surgery.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 research contract - Department of Medical and Surgical Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-21 Ginecologia e ostetricia

Title of the project: “Clinical-Translational study on the impact of obesity-related immunometabolic alterations in early-stage endometrial cancer and on preoperative modulation of the tumor microenvironment through tirzepatide” - Prospective clinical-translational study aimed at investigating the impact of obesity-related immunometabolic alterations in early-stage endometrial cancer. Patients with BMI >= 27 scheduled for hysterectomy will undergo ashort preoperative exposure to tirzepatide. Tumor tissue, visceral adipose tissue and peripheral blood samples will be collected before and after treatment..Omissis.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Sistema Intelligente di Fitodepurazione applicata alle colture microalgali e valorizzazione delle sostanze bioattive per la salute umana e la sostenibilità ambientale – SIMBio (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-24 Statistica medica, igiene generale e applicata e scienze infermieristiche generali, cliniche, pediatriche e ostetrico-ginecologiche e neonatali

The research aims to develop an innovative and sustainable system for wastewater treatment using microalgal cultures of the genus Scenedesmus spp., integrated with advanced monitoring technologies and predictive models based on artificial intelligence. Following an interdisciplinary One Health approach, the project seeks to optimize wastewater treatment processes and microalgal biomass production, while assessing its valorization through the extraction and stabilization of bioactive compounds with potential applications in nutraceuticals and preventive medicine. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Role of GIP and GLP1 receptors in breast cancer (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-08 Endocrinologia, nefrologia e scienze dell'alimentazione e del benessere

Over the two-year research period, the researcher will investigate the role of incretin receptors GIPR and GLP1R in breast cancer. Receptor expression will be characterized in tumor samples and through transcriptomic datasets, including TCGA, assessing associations with molecular subtypes, prognosis, and clinicopathological features. Functional in vitro studies will also be performed in breast cancer cell lines exposed to GIP and GLP-1 agonists to evaluate effects on proliferation, cellular metabolism, phenotypic plasticity, and oncogenic signaling. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Precision Oncology - Development of Specialist Skills for the Management and Annotation of Clinical and Molecular Oncology Data, with Particular Focus on Thoracic Malignancies (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-13 Chirurgia cardio-toraco-vascolare

The project will develop specialist skills in the management and annotation of clinical and molecular oncology data, with particular focus on thoracic malignancies. The biologist will contribute to an integrated database compliant with FAIR principles and the GDPR, NGS data analysis, and functional annotation of molecular alterations using public databases and international standards. Molecular profiles will be integrated with clinical data and outcomes through multivariable regression, survival analysis, and clustering to identify and validate diagnostic, prognostic, and predictive biomarkers and clinical-biological stratification models. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-24 Statistica medica, igiene generale e applicata e scienze infermieristiche generali, cliniche, pediatriche e ostetrico-ginecologiche e neonatali

Studies and research on tools and strategies for mapping and monitoring health and social-health infrastructures in relation to multidisciplinary cooperation models for the adaptation, support and strengthening of health systems at the territorial, urban and building scales, with particular reference to the use of advanced software, integrated management systems and meta-planning strategies.
